title: terradish: Fast Gradient-Based Optimization of Resistance Surfaces
description: Maximum likelihood estimation of landscape conductance surfaces from genetic data on raster graphs, using Newton and quasi-Newton optimization with analytic derivatives. Fits log-linear conductance models with optional joint estimation of Gaussian smoothing scales and spline response shapes, linked to pairwise genetic distances through maximum likelihood population effects models or to allele-frequency covariance through a Wishart likelihood on site contrasts, with the same pairwise distance and environment covariates available in both. Provides exact sparse and algebraic multigrid solvers for large rasters, fixed-domain spatial cross-validation for comparing conductance formulas, and simulation tools for study design. Works natively with 'terra' objects.
